title: Tiny, cute hammer
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='headGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c9d4e0'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#8a9bb0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6a7d94'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handleGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8b878'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#d49a4e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b87c34'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='36' width='14' height='52' rx='7' fill='url(#handleGrad)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='40' width='4' height='44' rx='2' fill='#f5d9a8' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- handle bottom cap -->
  <rect x='43' y='82' width='16' height='8' rx='4' fill='#a06828'/>
  <rect x='46' y='84' width='4' height='4' rx='2' fill='#d4a060' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- hammer head -->
  <rect x='14' y='16' width='72' height='26' rx='8' fill='url(#headGrad)'/>
  <!-- top shine -->
  <rect x='20' y='19' width='60' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#eef3f8' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- left face -->
  <rect x='14' y='16' width='14' height='26' rx='7' fill='#9fb0c4'/>
  <rect x='16' y='19' width='4' height='20' rx='2' fill='#dce6ef' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- right face -->
  <rect x='72' y='16' width='14' height='26' rx='7' fill='#9fb0c4'/>
  <rect x='74' y='19' width='4' height='20' rx='2' fill='#dce6ef' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- centre band -->
  <rect x='40' y='16' width='20' height='26' fill='#a9b9cc'/>
  <rect x='44' y='19' width='12' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e0e8f0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- tiny face on head: cute eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='31' r='3' fill='#3a5aa8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='31' r='3' fill='#3a5aa8'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='30' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='30' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M47 35 Q50 38 53 35' stroke='#3a5aa8' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#ff9fb0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#ff9fb0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <path d='M26 12 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 z' fill='#fff6b0' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M74 10 l1.2 2.4 2.4 1.2 -2.4 1.2 -1.2 2.4 -1.2 -2.4 -2.4 -1.2 2.4 -1.2 z' fill='#fff6b0' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
